code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanUploadJob,jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,models/ToppanStage}, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl, framework/services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor, utilities/sftpComponent/SftpUtil, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository, framework/workflows/repccs/notice_creation/core/helpers/NoticeProcessingHelper, resources/{cron-schedules-prod,application-prod}.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant to this story
note: Status in stories.json: Requirement given - Gen flow, 1 point. For UPL notices (vehicle type X) the code uses the Demand Notice track: notices are created with next stage DN1 (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:403) and then DN2 and DR3, not RD1/RD2/RR3. The 2nd letter uses the same Toppan job as other notices (stage DN2). Three things lower the claim: (1) the 00:15 cron exists and is enabled in prod, but the executeJob() call in ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118 is commented out, so letters only go out through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters; (2) sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in application-prod.properties:86 blocks delivery to the vendor; (3) the delivery gate is bypassed and the stage still advances although the file was not delivered (ToppanUploadJob.java:418-446, OCMS-DF-2026-192 Ready to UAT). The UPL 'outstanding fine' depends on the decision/endorsement workflow (default composition_amount 0, NoticeProcessingHelper.java:406-408; tickets OCMS-SR-2026-155 and OCMS-SR-2026-185 show notices stuck at $0 and patched by hand). The story demo remark ('Ask Rafif if this function is ready') cannot be confirmed from the repo. The Toppan service, COMCRYPT, the printed letter content and per-environment property values: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially: notice selection, address and file generation exist, but the daily cron does not call the letter job and delivery to Toppan is blocked by config. Do not claim fully until SFTP is unblocked and the job is scheduled

steps.step: OCMS runs the Toppan letter job that processes stage DN2 (2nd letter reminder) for the vendor
steps.detail: The Toppan letter job processes stage DN2. The 00:15 schedule exists and is enabled in prod, but the call that generates letters is commented out at ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118, so only the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-43) runs it. When triggered, ToppanLettersGeneratorJob walks every ToppanStage value in order (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-154); DN2 is Demand Notice 2 (ToppanStage.java:23). UPL notices (vehicle type X) are created with next stage DN1 (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:403), so they follow DN1 -> DN2 -> DR3. Real server property values: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS selects notices entitled to the 2nd letter (next stage DN2, due, not suspended, offender Y) and takes the address from the latest particulars (letter_address)
steps.detail: findToppanNoticesForStage('DN2') picks notices with next_processing_stage = 'DN2', next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, no AN flag, joined to owner_driver with offender_indicator = 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:585-614); it is called from ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887 via ToppanUploadJob.java:248. Notices are enriched with addresses ordered mha_reg > lta_reg > lta_mail > furnished_mail (findAddressesForNoticesWithPriority, OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:616-641; called at ToppanUploadHelper.java:2020-2024), notices with no deliverable address are dropped (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2026-2050) and only letter_address = 'Y' continues (filterByLetterAddress, ToppanUploadHelper.java:2372; called at ToppanUploadJob.java:266). UPL note: the join needs an offender owner_driver row; the REPCCS create-notice flow only builds that row for military vehicles (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:727-737; no other creation found in the repccs folder), so where a UPL offender row comes from belongs to another story (OCMS13.1) and is not verified here. Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-185 says UPL processing logic was not developed and stages of three UPL notices were patched by hand.

steps.step: OCMS builds a data file (PDF/data) with the letter details, fine amount and due date for the vendor to print
steps.detail: File name URA-DPT-DN2-D1-<timestamp> (ToppanUploadJob.java:278-283); content comes from createRequestFileContent -> createToppanRequestFileContent (ToppanUploadJob.java:285-292; AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:564-566): a header plus fixed-width detail lines with notice no, name, address, vehicle no, place/rule infringed, Amount from amountPayable and Notice Expiry date from paymentDueDate (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:648-650, 729-733); NRIC is deliberately blank. For DN2, amount_payable = composition_amount with no admin fee (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2112-2127). PDF is only produced for stage ANL (ToppanUploadJob.java:323-324), so DN2 is a data file only; the story says 'PDF/data files', so that is enough. UPL note: UPL notices are created with composition_amount 0 and payment not accepted (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:406-408); the fine is only filled by the decision/endorsement workflow, which is not traced in this story. Tickets OCMS-SR-2026-155 and OCMS-SR-2026-185 show UPL notices stuck at $0 and patched by hand, so the 'outstanding fine' in the letter depends on that data (cannot verify from repo). The text the vendor prints: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The file is stored in Azure Blob, encrypted through COMCRYPT and sent to the vendor over the Toppan SFTP
steps.detail: The original file is uploaded to Azure Blob (uploadProcessor.uploadToBlob, ToppanUploadJob.java:314) and comcryptTokenHelper.requestToken asks for encryption (ToppanUploadJob.java:345-356); the COMCRYPT callback then puts the encrypted file on the Toppan SFTP. Delivery is blocked by config: sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in application-prod.properties:86 (also uat/dev). SftpUtil.isServerUploadDisabled (SftpUtil.java:111-113) makes ComcryptUploadProcessor throw SftpDisabledException and keep the operation record (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:206-209), so the DN2 file does not reach Toppan while that property is set (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT, not in prod). Real server property values, the COMCRYPT service and the Toppan SFTP: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After the 2nd letter is processed, the notice moves to the next stage (DR3) and is recorded as sent
steps.detail: The notice moves to DR3 (next stage, days from parameter) and last stage is set to DN2 through updateProcessingStage -> bulkUpdateVonStage (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1385-1423; amount_payable is computed and the admin fee is cleared at non-RR3/DR3 stages per the OCMS-DF-2026-170 fix); tracking for DN1/DN2/DR3 is recorded in ocms_driver_notice (ToppanUploadHelper.java:889-891). Partial because the delivery gate is bypassed while sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (ToppanUploadJob.java:418-446): the stage still advances although the file was not delivered, so the notice says the 2nd letter was sent when it was not (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT).
